Service scope

From specification to support.

Service scope is adapted to the system, client, procurement route and principal requirements.

Product sourcing & supply

Identifying the appropriate principal solution, coordinating commercial documentation and managing the supply path for institutional requirements.

Project coordination

Keeping specifications, timelines, site information, principal input and local responsibilities aligned throughout the project.

Installation & commissioning

Local installation assistance, system checks and coordination with principal specialists where the equipment or project requires it.

Troubleshooting & maintenance

Diagnosis, preventive checks, maintenance coordination and escalation to the manufacturer for issues requiring principal-level support.

Spare parts coordination

Identification and sourcing coordination for relevant replacement parts, consumables and approved components.

Client training

Operational orientation and system-specific training coordination for authorised client personnel, focused on safe operation and routine care.

After-sales support

A local point of contact for follow-up, maintenance planning, system questions and communication with the international manufacturer.

Tender & procurement support

Technical documentation coordination, manufacturer communication and clarification support for government and institutional procurement processes.

Technical continuity

Local response, backed by the principal.

Experienced technicians provide a first line of support in Bangladesh while VTI keeps the manufacturer connected whenever system-level input or approved parts are required.
